structuredData.headline: Henna Residensi Turnkey Rental Styling — New 2-Bedroom Unit Setup in Wangsa Maju, Kuala Lumpur
structuredData.description: A brand-new 2-bedroom, 1-bathroom unit at Henna Residensi in Wangsa Maju set up turnkey for rental on an RM 30,600 all-in budget. Features Scandinavian modern styling with a teal tufted sofa, blue-grey wainscoting walls, round light-wood dining set with green-upholstered chairs, compact two-tone kitchen, Daikin air conditioning, complete bedding with queen and single divans, and wood-look vinyl flooring throughout.
